# This is an edited version of SPLASH's supervised_test.Rmd
Here, I was playing around with different thresholds and frameworks (i.e. cv.glmnet) to make the supervised analysis more robust to noise

```{r}
  metadata = metadata[!is.na(V2)]

  metadata$sample_name = paste(metadata$cell_barcode,metadata$sample_name,sep="_")
```

```{r}
min_target_count <- 5   # <-- set your target-level threshold here
min_target_samples <- 3

passed_anchors_count = 0
for (counter in 1:nrow(selected_anchors)) {
  tryCatch({
    anchor_interest = selected_anchors$anchor[counter]
    counts_anchor = counts[anchor == anchor_interest]  # target counts for the selected anchor 
    
    # 1) compute total counts per target
    counts_anchor[, target_count := sum(count), by = target]
    
    # 2) DROP targets whose total count is below threshold
    counts_anchor = counts_anchor[target_count >= min_target_count]
    
    # If no targets (or only 1) survive, skip this anchor
    if (nrow(counts_anchor) == 0 || data.table::uniqueN(counts_anchor$target) < 2) {
      next
    }
    
    # 3) proceed as before: pick top targets among the remaining ones
    top_targets = counts_anchor[!duplicated(target)][order(-target_count)]$target[1:4]  # find top 4 targets
    counts_anchor[!target %in% top_targets, target := "other"]  # assign others to "other"
    counts_anchor = counts_anchor[target %in% top_targets][order(-target_count)]
    counts_anchor[, target_count := sum(count), by = target]
    counts_anchor = counts_anchor[!duplicated(paste(anchor, target, sample_name))]
    
    counts_anchor[, anchor_count_per_sample := sum(count), by = list(anchor, sample_name)]
    counts_anchor[, fraction := count / anchor_count_per_sample, by = 1:nrow(counts_anchor)]
    
    # You still have your per-sample anchor threshold here:
    counts_anchor = counts_anchor[anchor_count_per_sample > 5]
    
    # If this filtering wipes everything out, skip
    if (nrow(counts_anchor) == 0) next
    
    counts_anchor_reshape = reshape(counts_anchor[, list(sample_name, target, fraction, count)],
                                    idvar = "sample_name", timevar = "target", direction = "wide")

    if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 11){
      names(counts_anchor_reshape) = c("sample_name","target1_frac","target1_count","target2_frac","target2_count",
                                       "target3_frac","target3_count","target4_frac","target4_count","other_frac","other_count")
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 9){
      names(counts_anchor_reshape) = c("sample_name","target1_frac","target1_count","target2_frac","target2_count",
                                       "target3_frac","target3_count","target4_frac","target4_count")
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 7){
      names(counts_anchor_reshape) = c("sample_name","target1_frac","target1_count",
                                       "target2_frac","target2_count","target3_frac","target3_count")
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 5){
      names(counts_anchor_reshape) = c("sample_name","target1_frac","target1_count",
                                       "target2_frac","target2_count")
    }

    counts_anchor_reshape_wo_sample_name = copy(counts_anchor_reshape)
    counts_anchor_reshape_wo_sample_name[, sample_name := NULL]
    setnafill(counts_anchor_reshape_wo_sample_name, fill = 0)
    counts_anchor_reshape = cbind(counts_anchor_reshape$sample_name, counts_anchor_reshape_wo_sample_name)
    names(counts_anchor_reshape)[1] = "sample_name"
    
    sample_names = data.table(counts_anchor_reshape$sample_name)
    sample_names = merge(
      sample_names,
      counts_anchor[!duplicated(sample_name), list(sample_name, group)],
      all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE, by.x = "V1", by.y = "sample_name"
    )
    sample_names[, class := as.numeric(as.factor(group))]
    
    counts_anchor_reshape[, sample_name := NULL]
    
    if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 10){
      regression_formula = class ~ target1_frac + target2_frac + target3_frac + target4_frac + other_frac
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 8){
      regression_formula = class ~ target1_frac + target2_frac + target3_frac + target4_frac
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 6){
      regression_formula = class ~ target1_frac + target2_frac + target3_frac
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 4){
      regression_formula = class ~ target1_frac + target2_frac
    }

    counts_anchor_reshape = cbind(counts_anchor_reshape, sample_names$group, sample_names$class)
    setnames(counts_anchor_reshape, c("V2","V3"), c("group","class"))
    counts_anchor_reshape = counts_anchor_reshape[!is.na(group)]
    counts_anchor_reshape[, num_per_group := .N, by = group]
    counts_anchor_reshape[, weight := 1/num_per_group]
    counts_anchor_reshape = counts_anchor_reshape[num_per_group > 5]
    
    if (length(unique(counts_anchor_reshape$group)) > 1){
      x_glmnet = model.matrix(regression_formula, counts_anchor_reshape)
      glmnet_model = cv.glmnet(
        x_glmnet,
        as.factor(counts_anchor_reshape$group),
        family  = "multinomial",
        intercept = FALSE,
        alpha = 1,
        nlambda = 50,
        nfolds = 4,
        weights = counts_anchor_reshape$weight
      )
      glmnet_coeffs = coef(glmnet_model)
      largest_GLM_coefficient = max(unlist(lapply(lapply(glmnet_coeffs, abs), max)))
      
      if (largest_GLM_coefficient > 1){
        metadata_group_names = paste(names(glmnet_coeffs), collapse = "||")
        GLM_coefficients = paste(lapply(glmnet_coeffs, paste, collapse = ":"), collapse = "||")
        GLM_output_dt_anchor = cbind(selected_anchors[anchor == anchor_interest],
                                     metadata_group_names, GLM_coefficients, largest_GLM_coefficient)
        GLM_output_dt = rbind(GLM_output_dt, GLM_output_dt_anchor)
        passed_anchors_count = passed_anchors_count + 1
      }
    }
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

```

ALTERNATIVE OVERKILL VERSION
```{r}
passed_anchors_count = 0

# hyperparameters for noise robustness
min_samples_per_target      <- 3   # target must appear in at least 2 samples
min_total_counts_per_target <- 10   # target must have at least 5 total counts
min_anchor_counts_per_samp  <- 10  # per-sample anchor coverage
min_samples_per_group       <- 6   # you already enforce this
min_nonzero_per_group       <- 3   # per group, at least 2 samples with nonzero frac
max_cv_error_threshold      <- 0.35 # max allowed CV misclassification error

for (counter in 1:nrow(selected_anchors)) {
  tryCatch({
    anchor_interest = selected_anchors$anchor[counter]

    # ---- pull counts for this anchor ----
    counts_anchor = counts[anchor == anchor_interest]

    # if basically nothing there, skip early
    if (nrow(counts_anchor) == 0L) next

    # ---- per-sample anchor coverage filter (stronger) ----
    counts_anchor[, anchor_count_per_sample := sum(count), by = .(anchor, sample_name)]
    counts_anchor = counts_anchor[anchor_count_per_sample > min_anchor_counts_per_samp]

    # need at least 2 samples after this
    if (uniqueN(counts_anchor$sample_name) < 2L) next

    # ---- per-target metrics: total counts + #samples per target ----
    counts_anchor[, target_count := sum(count), by = target]
    counts_anchor[, target_sample_n := uniqueN(sample_name[count > 0]), by = target]

    # filter out ultra-rare / noisy targets
    counts_anchor = counts_anchor[
      target_sample_n >= min_samples_per_target &
      target_count    >= min_total_counts_per_target
    ]

    # if no targets survive or only one target left, skip
    if (nrow(counts_anchor) == 0L || uniqueN(counts_anchor$target) < 2L) next

    # recompute target_count after filtering and choose top targets
    counts_anchor[, target_count := sum(count), by = target]
    setorder(counts_anchor, -target_count)
    top_targets <- unique(counts_anchor$target)[1:min(4L, uniqueN(counts_anchor$target))]

    # collapse everything else into "other"
    counts_anchor[!target %in% top_targets, target := "other"]
    counts_anchor = counts_anchor[target %in% c(top_targets, "other")]
    counts_anchor[, target_count := sum(count), by = target]
    counts_anchor = counts_anchor[!duplicated(paste(anchor, target, sample_name))]

    # recompute per-sample anchor counts and fractions after collapsing
    counts_anchor[, anchor_count_per_sample := sum(count), by = .(anchor, sample_name)]
    counts_anchor[, fraction := count / anchor_count_per_sample]  # vectorized
    counts_anchor = counts_anchor[anchor_count_per_sample > min_anchor_counts_per_samp]

    # need at least 2 samples after all this
    if (uniqueN(counts_anchor$sample_name) < 2L) next

    # ---- reshape to wide (sample x targets) ----
    counts_anchor_reshape = reshape(
      counts_anchor[, .(sample_name, target, fraction, count)],
      idvar   = "sample_name",
      timevar = "target",
      direction = "wide"
    )

    # rename columns based on number of targets present
    if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 11) {
      names(counts_anchor_reshape) = c("sample_name",
                                       "target1_frac", "target1_count",
                                       "target2_frac", "target2_count",
                                       "target3_frac", "target3_count",
                                       "target4_frac", "target4_count",
                                       "other_frac",   "other_count")
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 9) {
      names(counts_anchor_reshape) = c("sample_name",
                                       "target1_frac", "target1_count",
                                       "target2_frac", "target2_count",
                                       "target3_frac", "target3_count",
                                       "target4_frac", "target4_count")
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 7) {
      names(counts_anchor_reshape) = c("sample_name",
                                       "target1_frac", "target1_count",
                                       "target2_frac", "target2_count",
                                       "target3_frac", "target3_count")
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 5) {
      names(counts_anchor_reshape) = c("sample_name",
                                       "target1_frac", "target1_count",
                                       "target2_frac", "target2_count")
    } else {
      # weird shape → skip
      next
    }

    # ---- fill NAs with 0 in numeric columns ----
    counts_anchor_reshape_wo_sample_name = copy(counts_anchor_reshape)
    counts_anchor_reshape_wo_sample_name[, sample_name := NULL]
    setnafill(counts_anchor_reshape_wo_sample_name, fill = 0)
    counts_anchor_reshape = cbind(
      sample_name = counts_anchor_reshape$sample_name,
      counts_anchor_reshape_wo_sample_name
    )

    # ---- attach group and class ----
    sample_names = data.table(counts_anchor_reshape$sample_name)
    sample_names = merge(
      sample_names,
      counts_anchor[!duplicated(sample_name), .(sample_name, group)],
      all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE,
      by.x = "V1", by.y = "sample_name"
    )
    sample_names[, class := as.numeric(as.factor(group))]

    counts_anchor_reshape[, sample_name := NULL]

    # define regression formula based on which frac cols exist
    if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 10) {
      regression_formula = class ~ target1_frac + target2_frac + target3_frac + target4_frac + other_frac
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 8) {
      regression_formula = class ~ target1_frac + target2_frac + target3_frac + target4_frac
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 6) {
      regression_formula = class ~ target1_frac + target2_frac + target3_frac
    } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 4) {
      regression_formula = class ~ target1_frac + target2_frac
    } else {
      next
    }

    counts_anchor_reshape = cbind(
      counts_anchor_reshape,
      group = sample_names$group,
      class = sample_names$class
    )

    counts_anchor_reshape = counts_anchor_reshape[!is.na(group)]
    counts_anchor_reshape[, num_per_group := .N, by = group]
    counts_anchor_reshape[, weight := 1 / num_per_group]
    counts_anchor_reshape = counts_anchor_reshape[num_per_group >= min_samples_per_group]

    # need at least two groups with data
    if (length(unique(counts_anchor_reshape$group)) <= 1L) next

    # ---- extra: per-group nonzero check to avoid 1-sample artifacts ----
    frac_cols <- grep("_frac$", names(counts_anchor_reshape), value = TRUE)
    nonzero_by_group <- counts_anchor_reshape[
      ,
      lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(x > 0)),
      by = group,
      .SDcols = frac_cols
    ]

    # require each group to have at least `min_nonzero_per_group`
    # samples with nonzero fraction in at least one target
    if (any(apply(nonzero_by_group[, -1], 1, max) < min_nonzero_per_group)) next

    # ---- GLMnet multinomial regression ----
    x_glmnet = model.matrix(regression_formula, counts_anchor_reshape)

    glmnet_model = cv.glmnet(
      x_glmnet,
      as.factor(counts_anchor_reshape$group),
      family       = "multinomial",
      intercept    = FALSE,
      alpha        = 0.5,       # elastic net: more stable than pure lasso
      nlambda      = 50,
      nfolds       = 4,
      weights      = counts_anchor_reshape$weight,
      type.measure = "class"    # use misclassification error
    )

    # cross-validated misclassification error
    min_cv_err <- min(glmnet_model$cvm)

    # skip noisy/unreliable anchors that don't classify well
    if (min_cv_err > max_cv_error_threshold) next

    glmnet_coeffs = coef(glmnet_model)
    largest_GLM_coefficient = max(unlist(lapply(lapply(glmnet_coeffs, abs), max)))

    # require reasonably strong effect size too
    if (largest_GLM_coefficient > 2) {
      metadata_group_names = paste(names(glmnet_coeffs), collapse = "||")
      GLM_coefficients     = paste(lapply(glmnet_coeffs, paste, collapse = ":"), collapse = "||")

      GLM_output_dt_anchor = cbind(
        selected_anchors[anchor == anchor_interest],
        metadata_group_names,
        GLM_coefficients,
        largest_GLM_coefficient
      )
      GLM_output_dt = rbind(GLM_output_dt, GLM_output_dt_anchor)

      passed_anchors_count = passed_anchors_count + 1

      # plotting (unchanged from your version)
      pdf(file = paste0(directory, "/", run_name,
                        "_supervised_metadata/plots/", anchor_interest, ".pdf"),
          width = 12, height = 6)

      if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 14) {
        long_counts_anchor_reshape <- melt(
          setDT(counts_anchor_reshape[
            , .(target1_frac, target2_frac, target3_frac, target4_frac, other_frac, group)
          ]),
          id.vars = c("group")
        )
        counts_anchor_reshape_df = data.frame(
          counts_anchor_reshape[
            , .(target1_frac, target2_frac, target3_frac, target4_frac, other_frac)
          ]
        )
      } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 12) {
        long_counts_anchor_reshape <- melt(
          setDT(counts_anchor_reshape[
            , .(target1_frac, target2_frac, target3_frac, target4_frac, group)
          ]),
          id.vars = c("group")
        )
        counts_anchor_reshape_df = data.frame(
          counts_anchor_reshape[
            , .(target1_frac, target2_frac, target3_frac, target4_frac)
          ]
        )
      } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 10) {
        long_counts_anchor_reshape <- melt(
          setDT(counts_anchor_reshape[
            , .(target1_frac, target2_frac, target3_frac, group)
          ]),
          id.vars = c("group")
        )
        counts_anchor_reshape_df = data.frame(
          counts_anchor_reshape[
            , .(target1_frac, target2_frac, target3_frac)
          ]
        )
      } else if (ncol(counts_anchor_reshape) == 8) {
        long_counts_anchor_reshape <- melt(
          setDT(counts_anchor_reshape[
            , .(target1_frac, target2_frac, group)
          ]),
          id.vars = c("group")
        )
        counts_anchor_reshape_df = data.frame(
          counts_anchor_reshape[
            , .(target1_frac, target2_frac)
          ]
        )
      }

      g1 = ggplot(long_counts_anchor_reshape,
                  aes(x = group, y = value, fill = as.factor(variable))) +
        geom_boxplot() + theme_bw() + ggtitle(anchor_interest)

      g2 = ggplot(counts_anchor_reshape,
                  aes(x = target1_count, y = target2_count,
                      shape = as.factor(group), color = as.factor(group))) +
        geom_point() + theme_bw()

      rownames(counts_anchor_reshape_df) = c(1:nrow(counts_anchor_reshape_df))
      my_annotation_row = data.frame(counts_anchor_reshape$group)
      rownames(my_annotation_row) = rownames(counts_anchor_reshape_df)
      names(my_annotation_row) = "group"

      g3 = pheatmap(counts_anchor_reshape_df,
                    annotation_row = my_annotation_row,
                    show_rownames   = FALSE,
                    cluster_cols    = FALSE)

      print(grid.arrange(grobs = list(g1, g2, g3[[4]]),
                         layout_matrix = rbind(c(1, 3),
                                               c(2, 3))))
      dev.off()
    }
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

write.table(
  GLM_output_dt,
  paste0(directory, "/", run_name, "_supervised_metadata/GLM_supervised_anchors.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)

writeLines(
  paste("Nice! ", passed_anchors_count, " anchors passed the GLM analysis."),
  paste0(directory, "/", run_name, "_supervised_metadata/passed_anchors_summary.txt")
)
```
